subject: Music Production
title: Max Martin's Pop Formula
description: A quick, practical guide to Max Martin's Pop Formula.

hook.text: Swedish songwriter Max Martin grew up studying melodic patterns in ABBA's hit catalog.

buildup.text: He developed a formula combining catchy melodies, simple lyrics, and driving rhythmic hooks.

discovery.text: Martin's approach produced number-one hits for Britney Spears, Backstreet Boys, and NSYNC.

twist.text: Despite writing more number-one hits than almost anyone, Martin avoided all public attention.

climax.text: He has written or produced over twenty-five Billboard number-one singles across three decades.

punchline.text: Pop music's most prolific hitmaker hides from fame.

quiz.question: What distinguished Max Martin's approach to songwriting?
options: A formula of catchy melodies, simple lyrics, and hooks
